terra.problem: “The LORD gives victory” says Israel took the land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, but Deuteronomy 2:31–36 does not give that full boundary. Add Numbers 21:24 to the passage or remove the boundary detail.
“Israel recalls the battle” describes Jephthah’s account to Ammon’s king, not an event said to take place at Jahaz. Reframe the moment around the battle at Jahaz.
